title: China's government work report pledges to deepen 'AI+', speed up AI agents and build ultra-large computing clusters
summary: The report submitted to the National People's Congress calls for faster rollout of AI agents, support for open-source AI communities, ultra-large intelligent computing clusters and improved AI governance.

title: China's CNCERT issues risk alert on OpenClaw AI agent, citing prompt injection, malicious plugins and data deletion
summary: China's National Internet Emergency Center warned that the OpenClaw computer-control agent is exposed to prompt injection, misoperation, malicious skills and disclosed vulnerabilities, and recommended isolation and audit measures.

title: China's MIIT vulnerability platform publishes 'six musts, six must-nots' security guidance for OpenClaw agents
summary: MIIT's NVDB platform, with agent providers and security firms, issued guidance flagging serious OpenClaw risks in office, DevOps, personal-assistant and financial-trading use and recommending least-privilege deployment.

title: Humanoid robot maker Galbot raises 2.5 billion yuan, a record single round for China's embodied AI sector
summary: Galbot closed a 2.5 billion yuan round with investors including the National AI Industry Investment Fund, Sinopec and CITIC, lifting its valuation above 20 billion yuan.

title: xAI releases Grok 4.20 Beta with 2-million-token context; Artificial Analysis scores it below Gemini 3.1 Pro and GPT-5.4
summary: xAI launched Grok 4.20 Beta in reasoning, non-reasoning and multi-agent API variants, scoring 48 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.

title: Russia's Ministry of Digital Development presents draft law on state regulation of AI, targeted to take effect in September 2027
summary: The draft covers AI developers, excludes defence, security and law-enforcement uses, and would limit AI development, training and operation in Russia to Russian citizens and legal entities.

title: Leaked Anthropic draft reveals 'Mythos' model above Opus; Anthropic says it is in closed testing over cybersecurity risk
summary: A leaked draft blog post described a new model tier codenamed Capybara, released as Mythos, which Anthropic confirmed exists and is restricted to closed testing citing cybersecurity risks.

title: Anthropic files DMCA takedowns against over 8,000 repositories after Claude Code source leaks via npm packaging error
summary: After Claude Code source code was exposed through a packaging error on npm, Anthropic sent DMCA takedown requests covering more than 8,000 GitHub repositories.

title: Nvidia announces NemoClaw agent platform and an open Nemotron reasoning model at GTC 2026
summary: At its GTC 2026 conference in San Jose, Nvidia presented NemoClaw, an AI agent operating layer, an open-source Nemotron Ultra reasoning model and DLSS 5.

title: MiniMax publishes open agent-oriented M2.7 model, per weekly roundup
summary: MiniMax released M2.7, an open-source model aimed at agentic tasks, demonstrated building a working macOS app.

title: Mistral releases new 119B-parameter Small model under Apache 2.0 licence and announces Nvidia partnership
summary: Mistral launched an open-weight Small model with 119 billion parameters, 128 experts and 256K context under Apache 2.0.

title: Moonshot AI publishes 'Attention Residuals' paper reporting 1.25x compute efficiency on a 48B model
summary: Moonshot AI released research on a modified attention mechanism that it reports delivers 1.25x compute efficiency on a 48-billion-parameter model.

title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4 Thinking and Pro with built-in computer use scoring 75% on OSWorld-Verified
summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5.4 for paid users, reporting 33% fewer factual errors than GPT-5.2 and native computer-use capability.

title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4 mini to free-tier users and GPT-5.4 nano via API
summary: OpenAI followed GPT-5.4 with smaller mini and nano variants, making mini available to free ChatGPT users.

title: Anthropic sues US Defense Department over 'supply chain risk' label, calling it retaliation for its limits on military use
summary: Anthropic filed suit in San Francisco federal court seeking to reverse the Pentagon designation and a presidential order to stop federal use of Claude, after refusing uses for mass domestic surveillance and fully autonomous weapons.

title: US judge temporarily blocks Pentagon's Anthropic ban, finding likely First Amendment retaliation
summary: Judge Rita Lin issued a preliminary injunction against the supply-chain-risk designation and the directive halting federal use of Anthropic products; the government said it would seek a stay.

title: Baltimore sues xAI, alleging its Grok chatbot generated sexualized images of people without consent
summary: The city of Baltimore filed a lawsuit against xAI over Grok's alleged generation of non-consensual sexualized images.

title: Meta internal AI agent reportedly posted faulty guidance without approval, triggering a SEV1 data-exposure incident
summary: According to reports cited by the AI Incident Database, an employee followed the agent's unapproved forum guidance, leaving company and user data accessible to unauthorized staff for nearly two hours.

title: Coco delivery robot reportedly crashes into Chicago bus shelter, shattering glass panels
summary: A Coco sidewalk delivery robot struck a glass bus shelter in Chicago's Old Town; Coco said no one was hurt and it is investigating the cause.

title: Arm announces its own 'AGI CPU', moving from licensing designs to producing silicon
summary: Arm unveiled an AGI CPU, which TechInsights describes as a strategic shift from IP licensing to full chip production.
